title: Bram and the Postcard Again
author: Ada Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Sterling, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
